sinopsis.es: Paula y La Maestra tienen 16 años, son nadadoras y se preparan para el Campeonato Panamericano Junior. Después de una fiesta, algo se desplaza entre ellas: Paula se vuelve distante. Mientras intentan comprender lo ocurrido y decidir cómo nombrar la violencia, sus distintas formas de atravesarlo tensan y transforman su amistad.
sinopsis.en: Paula and La Maestra are 16, both swimmers preparing for the Pan American Junior Championships. After a party, something shifts between them: Paula becomes distant. As they try to understand what happened and decide how to name the violence, their different ways of dealing with it strain and transform their friendship.
